Thanks for your interest in the project, and sorry to head you off here.

**This project is not currently accepting external code contributions.**

The TI-99/4A Development Suite is maintained directly by KF1TZ Software, and
for now the codebase is kept under single authorship. That is a decision about
how the project is run, not a judgement about your change — and pull requests
opened without a prior discussion may be closed without review.

If you have found a problem or want a capability added, please open an issue
instead. Those are read and genuinely welcome:

- **Bug report** — <https://github.com/kenfitz/ti99-dev-suite/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml>
- **Feature request** — <https://github.com/kenfitz/ti99-dev-suite/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml>

If an issue leads to agreement that you should send a patch, this template can
be deleted and the pull request described normally.

You are of course free to fork the repository and change it for your own use
under the MIT licence.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full policy.
